title: 雅思·传媒与公共讨论 · 64 句
description: 新闻生产、平台与广告、误导信息、表达隐私、公共沟通和信息素养中的权衡。

items.zh: 抢先发布的压力可能减少核实时间。
items.en: Pressure to publish first can reduce time for verification.
answers: Pressure to publish first can reduce time for verification.

items.zh: 调查报道需要持续资源，而非一次性关注。
items.en: Investigative reporting requires sustained resources rather than momentary attention.
answers: Investigative reporting requires sustained resources rather than momentary attention.

items.zh: 新闻机构应说明更正了什么内容。
items.en: News organisations should explain precisely what they have corrected.
answers: News organisations should explain precisely what they have corrected.

items.zh: 匿名来源有时必要，但需要可靠的核实程序。
items.en: Anonymous sources can be necessary but require reliable verification.
answers: Anonymous sources can be necessary but require reliable verification.

items.zh: 现场报道也可能只呈现事件的一部分。
items.en: Even eyewitness reporting may capture only part of an event.
answers: Even eyewitness reporting may capture only part of an event.

items.zh: 如果标题只为搜索排名服务，使用生僻地名的地方新闻可能更难被发现。
items.en: When headlines serve search rankings alone, local stories using unfamiliar place names may become harder to find.
answers: When headlines serve search rankings alone, local stories using unfamiliar place names may become harder to find.
items.notes: when 限定情形；using 修饰地方新闻。

items.zh: 地方记者掌握的背景知识不容易被远程报道替代。
items.en: Local reporters' contextual knowledge is difficult to replace remotely.
answers: Local reporters' contextual knowledge is difficult to replace remotely.

items.zh: 新闻价值不完全取决于即时点击量。
items.en: Newsworthiness is not determined solely by immediate clicks.
answers: Newsworthiness is not determined solely by immediate clicks.
Newsworthiness isn't determined solely by immediate clicks.

items.zh: 订阅模式可能奖励忠实读者感兴趣的议题。
items.en: Subscriptions may favour topics attractive to loyal readers.
answers: Subscriptions may favour topics attractive to loyal readers.

items.zh: 广告收入下降可能削弱公共事务报道。
items.en: Declining advertising revenue can weaken public affairs coverage.
answers: Declining advertising revenue can weaken public affairs coverage.

items.zh: 免费内容不意味着生产没有成本。
items.en: Free access does not mean content costs nothing to produce.
answers: Free access does not mean content costs nothing to produce.
Free access doesn't mean content costs nothing to produce.

items.zh: 资助来源透明有助于读者判断潜在偏向。
items.en: Transparent funding helps readers assess potential bias.
answers: Transparent funding helps readers assess potential bias.

items.zh: 新闻补助应避免把编辑判断交给资助者。
items.en: News subsidies should avoid transferring editorial judgement to funders.
answers: News subsidies should avoid transferring editorial judgement to funders.

items.zh: 付费墙可能限制低收入读者获取信息。
items.en: Paywalls can restrict information access for lower-income readers.
answers: Paywalls can restrict information access for lower-income readers.

items.zh: 流量奖励可能鼓励重复发布而非深入调查。
items.en: Traffic incentives may encourage repetition instead of deeper investigation.
answers: Traffic incentives may encourage repetition instead of deeper investigation.

items.zh: 多元收入来源也不能替代职业规范。
items.en: Diversified revenue cannot substitute for professional standards.
answers: Diversified revenue cannot substitute for professional standards.
Diversified revenue can't substitute for professional standards.

items.zh: 平台排序会影响哪些议题进入公众视野。
items.en: Platform rankings influence which issues enter public awareness.
answers: Platform rankings influence which issues enter public awareness.

items.zh: 用户选择也受到默认设置影响。
items.en: User choices are also shaped by default settings.
answers: User choices are also shaped by default settings.

items.zh: 推荐系统需要提供可理解的控制方式。
items.en: Recommendation systems need understandable user controls.
answers: Recommendation systems need understandable user controls.

items.zh: 减少曝光和删除内容具有不同后果。
items.en: Reduced visibility and removal have different consequences.
answers: Reduced visibility and removal have different consequences.

items.zh: 审核规则应区分恶意行为和无意错误。
items.en: Moderation should distinguish malicious conduct from accidental errors.
answers: Moderation should distinguish malicious conduct from accidental errors.

items.zh: 自动识别可能难以理解讽刺。
items.en: Automated detection may struggle to recognise satire.
answers: Automated detection may struggle to recognise satire.

items.zh: 小语种用户也需要有效的申诉渠道。
items.en: Minority-language users also need effective appeals.
answers: Minority-language users also need effective appeals.

items.zh: 平台规模越大，错误规则的影响范围可能越广。
items.en: Greater platform scale can amplify the effects of flawed rules.
answers: Greater platform scale can amplify the effects of flawed rules.

items.zh: 信息缺口可能使谣言更容易传播。
items.en: Information gaps can make rumours easier to spread.
answers: Information gaps can make rumours easier to spread.

items.zh: 更正事实需要考虑原有情绪与信任。
items.en: Fact correction must consider existing emotions and trust.
answers: Fact correction must consider existing emotions and trust.

items.zh: 为了嘲讽而转发虚假说法，也可能把它传播给原本不会看到它的人。
items.en: Sharing a false claim to ridicule it can carry it beyond its original audience.
answers: Sharing a false claim to ridicule it can carry it beyond its original audience.
items.notes: to ridicule 表目的，与传播扩大的后果形成张力。

items.zh: 可靠消息应在危机早期就容易获取。
items.en: Reliable information should be accessible early in a crisis.
answers: Reliable information should be accessible early in a crisis.

items.zh: 夸张的反驳可能损害纠错者的可信度。
items.en: Exaggerated rebuttals can damage the corrector's credibility.
answers: Exaggerated rebuttals can damage the corrector's credibility.

items.zh: 错误信息既可能故意制造，也可能误传。
items.en: False information may be manufactured deliberately or shared unwittingly.
answers: False information may be manufactured deliberately or shared unwittingly.

items.zh: 真假标签无法解释复杂证据中的全部细节。
items.en: Binary truth labels cannot explain every evidential nuance.
answers: Binary truth labels cannot explain every evidential nuance.
Binary truth labels can't explain every evidential nuance.

items.zh: 有效纠错应提供清楚的替代解释。
items.en: Effective correction should offer a clear alternative explanation.
answers: Effective correction should offer a clear alternative explanation.

items.zh: 广告与编辑内容混合时，读者可能难以识别商业目的。
items.en: Blended advertising and editorial content can obscure commercial intent.
answers: Blended advertising and editorial content can obscure commercial intent.

items.zh: 明星代言不能证明产品效果。
items.en: Celebrity endorsement does not demonstrate product effectiveness.
answers: Celebrity endorsement does not demonstrate product effectiveness.
Celebrity endorsement doesn't demonstrate product effectiveness.

items.zh: 针对不安全感的营销可能加重消费压力。
items.en: Marketing to insecurities can intensify pressure to consume.
answers: Marketing to insecurities can intensify pressure to consume.

items.zh: 如果赞助说明只在视频结束后出现，观众观看推广内容时可能并不知情。
items.en: If sponsorship is disclosed only after a video ends, viewers may watch the promotion without knowing who funded it.
answers: If sponsorship is disclosed only after a video ends, viewers may watch the promotion without knowing who funded it.
items.notes: if 引出披露时机的问题；who funded it 明确需知信息。

items.zh: 儿童可能无法理解推广者的经济动机。
items.en: Children may not understand promoters' financial motives.
answers: Children may not understand promoters' financial motives.

items.zh: 个性化广告需要对数据使用作出限制。
items.en: Personalised advertising requires limits on data use.
answers: Personalised advertising requires limits on data use.

items.zh: 比较广告应使用可核实的标准。
items.en: Comparative advertising should use verifiable criteria.
answers: Comparative advertising should use verifiable criteria.

items.zh: 限制广告不能代替改善产品信息。
items.en: Advertising restrictions cannot replace better product information.
answers: Advertising restrictions cannot replace better product information.
Advertising restrictions can't replace better product information.

items.zh: 公开讨论应允许批评，也应考虑可预见的伤害。
items.en: Public discussion should allow criticism while considering foreseeable harm.
answers: Public discussion should allow criticism while considering foreseeable harm.

items.zh: 公共人物并不因此失去所有隐私。
items.en: Public figures do not thereby lose all privacy.
answers: Public figures do not thereby lose all privacy.
Public figures don't thereby lose all privacy.

items.zh: 报道弱势者需要避免再次伤害。
items.en: Reporting on vulnerable people should avoid compounding harm.
answers: Reporting on vulnerable people should avoid compounding harm.

items.zh: 匿名表达可以保护面临报复的人。
items.en: Anonymous expression can protect people facing retaliation.
answers: Anonymous expression can protect people facing retaliation.

items.zh: 一项禁令的适用范围应清楚界定。
items.en: The scope of a restriction should be clearly defined.
answers: The scope of a restriction should be clearly defined.

items.zh: 批评制度与骚扰个人应加以区分。
items.en: Criticism of institutions should be distinguished from personal harassment.
answers: Criticism of institutions should be distinguished from personal harassment.

items.zh: 同意接受一次采访，不应被解释为允许无限期重复使用录音。
items.en: Consent to one interview should not be interpreted as permission to reuse the recording indefinitely.
answers: Consent to one interview should not be interpreted as permission to reuse the recording indefinitely.
Consent to one interview shouldn't be interpreted as permission to reuse the recording indefinitely.
items.notes: be interpreted as：被解释为；indefinitely：无限期。

items.zh: 保留档案也需要考虑个人信息的长期影响。
items.en: Archiving must consider the lasting effects of personal disclosures.
answers: Archiving must consider the lasting effects of personal disclosures.

items.zh: 风险沟通应给出人们可以采取的行动。
items.en: Risk communication should specify actions people can take.
answers: Risk communication should specify actions people can take.

items.zh: 承认不确定性有时比过度保证更可信。
items.en: Acknowledging uncertainty can be more credible than excessive reassurance.
answers: Acknowledging uncertainty can be more credible than excessive reassurance.

items.zh: 公共说明需要适应不同语言能力。
items.en: Public explanations need to accommodate differing language abilities.
answers: Public explanations need to accommodate differing language abilities.

items.zh: 居民反复询问同一个细节，可能说明公告结构需要调整，而不是居民没有认真阅读。
items.en: Repeated questions about one detail may indicate a poorly structured notice rather than inattentive readers.
answers: Repeated questions about one detail may indicate a poorly structured notice rather than inattentive readers.
items.notes: rather than 对照信息设计与读者行为两种解释。

items.zh: 反复改变说法而不解释原因会损害信任。
items.en: Unexplained message changes can undermine trust.
answers: Unexplained message changes can undermine trust.

items.zh: 沟通效果不能只按发布次数衡量。
items.en: Communication effectiveness cannot be measured by publication frequency alone.
answers: Communication effectiveness cannot be measured by publication frequency alone.
Communication effectiveness can't be measured by publication frequency alone.

items.zh: 专业术语应在必要时解释，而不是一概删除。
items.en: Technical terms need explanation where necessary, not blanket removal.
answers: Technical terms need explanation where necessary, not blanket removal.

items.zh: 面对不同人群可以调整表达，但不应改变事实。
items.en: Wording can vary by audience without altering the facts.
answers: Wording can vary by audience without altering the facts.

items.zh: 媒体素养还包括理解编辑如何选择议题，因为未被报道的事情也会影响公众认识。
items.en: Media literacy includes understanding editorial selection, since omissions can also shape public awareness.
answers: Media literacy includes understanding editorial selection, since omissions can also shape public awareness.
items.notes: since 引出选题机制值得理解的理由。

items.zh: 读者需要识别哪些问题尚未得到回答。
items.en: Readers need to identify questions that remain unanswered.
answers: Readers need to identify questions that remain unanswered.

items.zh: 怀疑一切与认真核实并不是同一回事。
items.en: Universal suspicion is different from careful verification.
answers: Universal suspicion is different from careful verification.

items.zh: 理解统计口径有助于避免误导性比较。
items.en: Understanding statistical definitions helps prevent misleading comparisons.
answers: Understanding statistical definitions helps prevent misleading comparisons.

items.zh: 多看来源只有在来源独立时才更有意义。
items.en: Multiple sources help more when they are genuinely independent.
answers: Multiple sources help more when they are genuinely independent.

items.zh: 读者若只接受符合自身立场的更正，就可能对相似证据采用不同标准。
items.en: Readers who accept only corrections that suit their views may apply different standards to similar evidence.
answers: Readers who accept only corrections that suit their views may apply different standards to similar evidence.
items.notes: 嵌套定语从句限定选择性接受更正的读者。

items.zh: 教育可以让学生练习修正自己的结论。
items.en: Education can let students practise revising their conclusions.
answers: Education can let students practise revising their conclusions.

items.zh: 愿意暂缓判断是合理的信息习惯。
items.en: Willingness to suspend judgement is a sensible information habit.
answers: Willingness to suspend judgement is a sensible information habit.
